changsheng.section: 安長生沐浴冠帶臨官帝旺衰病死墓絶胎養
changsheng.quote: 火局命寅起長生 木局命亥起長生 水局命申起長生 土局命申起長生 金局命巳起長生 男命順女命逆
changsheng.glyph_note: 繁简和絶/絕、飬/養作明示规范化，不以本批证明每个历史字形的唯一性。

boshi.section_as_read: 安十二宮大歲殺祿神歌訣
boshi.quote: 博士力士青龍續 小耗將軍及奏書 蜚廉喜神病符錄 大耗伏兵至官府 要知不拘男女命尋祿存星起 陽男陰女順推輪陰男陽女逆流行
boshi.layer_note: 本节蜚廉对应博士层飞廉，与另一年支星蜚廉分层，不另造岁前十二神。

lucun.quote: 甲生祿存在寅宮 乙生在卯丙戊巳 丁己祿存在午方 庚祿居申辛祿酉 壬祿在亥癸祿子

unknown_gender_derivation: Evaluate both source-allowed directions and retain a label only if both agree. The start and opposite labels are invariant for the twelve distinct-name cycles; this is a derivation, not a claim that the text discusses unknown gender.
limits: One manual reader of a Ming edition, no expert double adjudication or whole-book certificate.
The software baseline uses year polarity for changsheng, which differs from this Ming male/female rule for yin-year births; preserve that difference.
Bureau element and natal year stem are supplied inputs; this comparison does not certify their calendar/prerequisite derivation.
Cycle labels are historical symbolic names, not clinical conditions, lifespan or empirical predictions.
